name: bitcalendar
description: Bitcalendar: the 128bit pixel calendar. Web app in app/, Android in android/, Windows in desktop/.

scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.share: cp app/js/recur.js supabase/functions/bitcal-reminders/recur.js && cp app/js/recur.js app/js/gsync.js app/js/google.js supabase/functions/bitcal-google/
